decision_conditions: There are judged to be no sound arboricultural or overbearing practical reasons for the works in the manner proposed, the effects of which would prejudice the trees' appearance and amenity value. Notwithstanding this, should a further application be submitted, the council may agree lesser works on the grounds of reasonable maintenance, such as crown lifting and removal of trunk epicormic shoots and trimming back of the overhang of T2 to maintain clearance from the house.
